statements.statement: The policy covers a hire car after the vehicle was stolen.
statements.quote: [4.4 Replacement vehicle] While the vehicle is off the road for repairs after a covered collision, or after it has been stolen, we pay for a hire car of similar size

statements.statement: The policy covers a hire car for up to 14 days after the vehicle was stolen.
statements.quote: [4.4 Replacement vehicle] ... for no more than 14 days.

statements.statement: The policy pays for a daily rate of up to $40.
statements.quote: [4.4 Replacement vehicle] at up to $40 a day
